title: Manganese anodes for neutral electrolyte primary metal–air batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01413H, Paper
Quinik L. Reyes-Morales, J. Rene Rangel-Mendez, Luis F. Chazaro-Ruiz
A metallic manganese anode in metal–air batteries achieved an energy density of 1859 W h kg−1 and a specific capacity of 1930 A h kg−1.
